panels.scene: Noon sunlight on an empty rooftop. A young woman sits alone on the ground in the shadow of a water tank, holding a phone to her ear.

characters.pose: Sitting on the ground with her knees up, holding a phone to her ear

panels.scene: Close-up of a smartphone screen held in one hand, the screen glowing, showing a missed-call notification icon.

objects.caption: A smartphone held in one hand, screen facing the viewer

panels.scene: A metal rooftop door bursts open. A young man rushes through it, out of breath, raising two lunch boxes high in one hand.

characters.pose: Running forward through an open metal door, one arm raised holding two stacked lunch boxes

bubbles.speaker: hao
bubbles.text: 對不起！排隊排到一半被教授抓去搬東西！

panels.scene: The young woman sits with her arms crossed, turning her face away to the side in a sulk.

characters.pose: Sitting with arms crossed, head turned away to the side

panels.scene: The young man holds out a lunch box toward the young woman. A small handwritten paper note is taped on the lid. She glances at the note, her ears slightly red.

characters.pose: Seen from behind over his shoulder, holding out a lunch box with both hands
Sitting, glancing sideways at the lunch box

objects.caption: A plastic lunch box with a small paper note taped on the lid
